summary: Robo.ai Inc. (Nasdaq: AIIO), a UAE-based US-listed company, reported that its indirectly wholly owned subsidiary Roboai Investments L.L.C-FZ served notice of termination on seller Yuntao Liu on September 10, 2026, terminating the February 19, 2026 share purchase agreement for 51% of Chinasky Car Trading FZE. Consideration had been US$1,000,000, payable in 7,388,799 Class B ordinary shares on a pre-reverse-split basis. No shares were issued, no target equity transferred, and no payments made. The termination was immediate under Section 11.1(b). Watch for any dispute over termination grounds and use of the authorized but unissued share capacity.
